meta.title: Moroccan Darija Dataset Source Registry
meta.purpose: Central index of source families reported by the repository. This registry summarizes declarations; it is not independent legal clearance.

sources.rights_holder: ArCode Standard (as declared in repository records)
sources.source_locator_policy: No per-record external locator is applicable to original editorial work; retain contributor and edit history where available.
sources.notes: The repository classifies 656 records as original. Its rights inventory reports that 71 of these were editorially rewritten from web sources in releases 1.9.1–1.9.3. Therefore source_type=original must not be treated as proof of wholly independent creation. Record-level source mapping and rights review remain necessary.

sources.rights_holder: Upstream contributors and applicable rights holders
sources.license: CC BY-NC 4.0 (as reported by this repository)
sources.source_locator_policy: Record the exact upstream file, record identifier, or commit whenever it can be established.
sources.notes: The repository reports 271 records from DODa, including records re-documented from other web sources and 40 additions in 1.10.1. Preserve upstream attribution and non-commercial conditions; verify current upstream terms and record-level mapping.

sources.source_name: Wattpad — source texts reported by the project
sources.rights_holder: Authors and other applicable rights holders
sources.license: No blanket license recorded for source stories
sources.source_locator_policy: Do not publish story text. Preserve private audit references only where lawful and permitted; do not infer permission from public accessibility.
sources.notes: The project reports that 126 lexical items were extracted from Wattpad stories and that story texts are not redistributed. The repository records redistribution/training as allowed and commercial use as not allowed, but this registry has not independently verified author permissions, platform terms, or the legal basis for extraction. Do not treat those recorded values as clearance; exclude from downstream redistribution/training until the rights basis is confirmed.

sources.source_name: Peace Corps Morocco — Moroccan Arabic Textbook (2011)
sources.rights_holder: United States Government publication status reported by repository; verify specific edition and components
sources.license: Public domain status reported by repository; verify before reuse
sources.source_locator_policy: Record page 163 and the exact glossary item when traceable.
sources.notes: The project reports 37 items from the verb glossary (page 163). A public-domain status is reported for the government publication, but verify the specific edition and exclude any third-party content. The repository's compilation and translation permissions remain subject to their own rights review.

unresolved_items: The registry does not yet map every lexical record to a source_id.
The exact upstream locator is not recorded for every imported item.
The legal basis and evidence for each permission claim have not been independently audited.
Rights for glosses, translations, examples, and transformations may differ from rights in the source term.
